name: Command-Line MCP Server
description: Allows AI assistants to safely execute common Unix/macOS terminal commands through a controlled interface with comprehensive security features.

rawRecord.description: Allows AI assistants to safely execute common Unix/macOS terminal commands through a controlled interface with comprehensive security features.

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_READ.description: Comma-separated list of read commands to add to the defaults

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_WRITE.description: Comma-separated list of write commands to add to the defaults

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_SYSTEM.description: Comma-separated list of system commands to add to the defaults

CMD_LINE_MCP_COMMANDS_BLOCKED.description: Comma-separated list of blocked commands to add to the defaults

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_REQUIRE_SESSION_ID.description: Whether to require a session ID for commands

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_WHITELISTED_DIRECT.description: Comma-separated list of directories that can be accessed without approval

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_ALLOW_COMMAND_SEPA.description: Whether to allow command chaining with separators like |, ;, &

CMD_LINE_MCP_SECURITY_AUTO_APPROVE_DIREC.description: Whether to automatically approve directories when using Claude Desktop
